name: GSA audience guidance (public development examples; no gold labels)

cases.prompt: Compare these two short guidance sentences for clarity and faithful meaning. Abstain if the task does not distinguish them.
cases.context: Keep the reader’s expertise and interests in view.
cases.a: Know the expertise and interest of your average reader, and write to that person.
cases.b: Find out what your average reader knows and cares about. Write for that person.
